strategy1.msg.help: You are the strategist: no body, only a camera over the land. WASD moves the camera, the wheel its height, Q/E turn, click/box chooses soldiers, right click orders, M the map, B the borders. To take a province, put up an outpost in it (Military tab) and put a soldier in it.
strategy1.msg.capital_fell: The capital of %s, %s, has fallen! The new capital is %s.
strategy1.msg.loot: Spoils: food %s, wood %s, stone %s, iron %s, gold %s.
strategy1.msg.raid: An army of %s (%s soldiers) marches on %s! They come in near x %s, z %s.
strategy1.msg.raid_beaten: The attack of %s on %s was beaten off!
strategy1.msg.season: Season %s: food %s (gathered less what folk and soldiers ate), wood +%s, stone +%s, iron +%s, gold +%s.
strategy1.msg.offer: %s offers peace. Offer peace back from Envoys on the map to make it.
strategy1.err.fallen: Your realm has fallen. Open the map → Realm to found a new one.
strategy1.err.garrison_full: The garrison is full — build walls.
strategy1.err.cost: Not enough (needs food %s, wood %s, stone %s, iron %s, gold %s).
strategy1.err.truce: The truce holds for %s more turn(s).
strategy1.err.army_full: Your army is full (%s soldiers). A new age allows more.
strategy1.err.recruit_here: The land round that province isn't loaded — move the camera there.
strategy1.err.nothing_to_give: Nothing in your pack the treasury wants (food, logs, stone, iron, gold, emeralds, diamonds).
strategy1.err.peace_early: %s won't talk of peace so soon.
strategy1.err.peace_wait: %s turned down peace not long ago — wait.
strategy1.ok.donated: To the treasury: food %s, wood %s, stone %s, iron %s, gold %s.
strategy1.map.title: Realms map
strategy1.map.pick: Pick a province on the map.
strategy1.map.sea_info: The sea can't be taken, but it leads to other shores.
strategy1.map.take_how: To take it: put up an outpost in the province (it must border your land) and put a soldier in it. The garrison comes out to fight: beat it, and the bar starts to fill.
strategy1.map.take_border: This province doesn't border your land. Take the ones between first.
strategy1.map.take_peace: You are at peace with its holder. Declare war to take it.
strategy1.map.no_land: Your realm has no land left.
strategy1.map.realm_help: Every turn (a minute) your provinces yield. Improve their economy, build walls, go on to a new age: it brings new soldiers and higher buildings. Rich deposits are what wars are fought over.
strategy1.map.recruit_where: Soldiers appear at the centre of your province under the camera (or the capital). Each eats 1 food a turn.
strategy1.map.orders: The army is led in the strategist view: choose with the mouse, right click to order.
strategy1.map.diplomacy_help: The AI realms fight each other and you. Peace can be offered after 3 turns of war; the stronger you are, the readier they are to take it.
strategy1.tip.eco: Farms, mills and mines: +50%% of the province's yield a level. Highest in your age: %s.
strategy1.tip.fort: Walls and towers: a stronger, larger garrison. Highest in your age: %s.
strategy1.tip.garrison: A garrison soldier: comes out to fight when an enemy nears the province.
strategy1.tip.war: Declare war: its provinces along your border can then be taken.
strategy1.tip.age: New soldiers, a larger army, higher buildings.
strategy1.tip.donate: Food, logs, planks, stone, iron, gold, emeralds and diamonds in your pack go to the treasury.
strategy1.tip.dismiss: Send home all your soldiers near (less food eaten).
strategy1.rts.title: Strategist
strategy1.rts.all_tip: Choose all your soldiers on the screen.
strategy1.rts.none_selected: Nobody chosen — click a soldier or drag a box
strategy1.rts.recruit_capital: Raising in the capital (look at a province of yours to raise there)
strategy1.rts.help: WASD — camera · wheel — height · Q/E — turn · click/box — choose · right click — go / attack / board / man · Tab — build · 1–5 — raise
strategy1.build.tower_wood.info: Up to 4 bowmen, shooting 30 blocks. Takes a ballista
strategy1.build.tower_stone.info: Up to 8 bowmen, shooting 36 blocks. A ballista, a catapult or a brazier
strategy1.err.build_short: Too short — mark the other end further away.
strategy1.err.build_long: Too long — build it in lengths.
strategy1.err.build_land: You can only build on your own land.
strategy1.err.build_water: A port goes on the shore: there must be water in front of it (the way its door faces).
strategy1.err.siege_full: You have as many siege engines as you may (%s).
strategy1.err.ships_full: You have as many ships as you may (%s).
strategy1.msg.stock: To try things out, %s of every resource went into your treasury.
strategy1.rts.unman_tip: An archer comes down to the army
strategy1.rts.line_end: %s: length %s · %s · click — build, right click — cancel
strategy1.rts.place: %s · %s · click — build, R — turn, right click — cancel
strategy1.rts.placing: Building: %s — pick the place (the white mark: the door's side)
strategy1.rts.placing_line: Building: %s — mark both ends (you can go on from the end)
strategy1.rts.help_place: Click to place, R turns, right click cancels
strategy1.build.keep.info: The heart of the realm: peasants come here, goods are brought here
strategy1.build.stockpile.info: Workers bring goods here, nearer than the keep
strategy1.build.woodcutter.info: 2 woodcutters fell the trees round it → wood. Put it right by the woods
strategy1.build.market.info: Sell and buy goods for gold, send caravans to neighbours
strategy1.build.blacksmith.info: Swordsmen, knights, guardsmen and the siege workshop
strategy1.build.bridge.info: Over water and gullies, bank to bank
strategy1.siege.trebuchet.info: Further and harder than a catapult
strategy1.ship.warship.info: 4 soldiers and a catapult on deck
strategy1.rts.help_line: Click start, click end, right click cancels
strategy1.rts.orders_tip: Right click: go / attack / board / man
strategy1.rts.army_tip: A soldier = an idle peasant + arms
strategy1.rts.build_tip2: Pick a building and click the place
strategy1.err.build_deposit: Quarries and mines go right on their deposit
strategy1.menu.tagline: Build, trade, wage war — on a land cut into hexagonal provinces
strategy1.mode.conquest.info: AI realms fight over land and deposits. Take their provinces.
strategy1.mode.siege.info: Build and gather by day; waves of the dead come at night, worse each time.
strategy1.mode.trade.info: No wars: who grows richest, by trade and crafts.
strategy1.mode.sandbox.info: Only you and the land: build in peace.
strategy1.wave.title: Night %s
strategy1.wave.subtitle: The dead are coming: %s
strategy1.site.title: Choose where your keep stands
strategy1.site.help: Point at the land and left-click: the keep stands there and the provinces are laid out round it. WASD, the wheel, Q/E to look about.
strategy1.site.water: A keep can't stand on water
strategy1.engine.1.info: Heavy bolts, far. Smashes the shield-bearers' shields
strategy1.err.no_water: There's no open water by the port for a ship.
strategy1.market.caravan_line: To the nearest realm at peace; comes back with gold
strategy1.err.caravans_busy: Every caravan is on the road (2 a market).
strategy1.err.no_partner: Nobody to trade with (a realm at peace is needed).
strategy1.msg.caravan_out: A caravan left for %s: ~%ss, will bring %s gold.
strategy1.msg.trade_won: %s grew %s richer first — the trading race is won!
strategy1.tab2.economy.info: Houses, stockpile, farms, woodcutters, quarries, mines and the market: all that feeds and enriches the realm.
strategy1.tab2.military.info: Barracks, blacksmith, siege workshop and port: where soldiers, engines and ships are made.
strategy1.tab2.defence.info: Towers and walls. Archers stand on them; towers can get a ballista, a catapult or a brazier.
strategy1.tab2.roads.info: Paths speed soldiers and carriers; bridges cross the water.
strategy1.tab2.army.info: Raise soldiers in the province under the camera. Each soldier is an idle peasant given arms.
strategy1.tip.map: The map of your realm and its neighbours (M)
strategy1.tip.per_block: Cost per block of length, up to %s blocks
strategy1.unit.militia.info: Cheap footman with a stone sword.
strategy1.unit.archer.info: Shoots from afar. Put them on towers and walls.
strategy1.unit.knight.info: Strong and quick, breaks the enemy's line.
strategy1.tip.unit_at_barracks: Comes out at these barracks' door
strategy1.tip.unit_here: Comes out at the nearest barracks of the province under the camera
strategy1.tip.demolish: Take the building down; its workers go idle
strategy1.tip.res.food.info: %s. Farms give it. Folk and soldiers eat every turn.
strategy1.tip.res.wood.info: %s. Woodcutters fell it. Most building needs it.
strategy1.tip.res.stone.info: %s. Quarries by stone outcrops dig it. Stone towers and walls need it.
strategy1.tip.res.iron.info: %s. Mines by iron veins dig it. Arms for swordsmen, knights and guards.
strategy1.tip.res.gold.info: %s. Gold mines, taxes from provinces, the market and caravans.
strategy1.tip.people.info: Folk and soldiers: %s of %s places. Houses give more places, and new peasants come.
strategy1.tip.idle.info: %s of %s with nothing to do. They work at farms, woodcutters, quarries and mines, help to build, and become soldiers when raised.
strategy1.tip.army.info: Soldiers: %s. Box them to choose, right click to order.
strategy1.tip.goal.info: Wealth grown %s of the %s needed to win. Rivals on the right.
strategy1.tip.wave.info: Night %s. Every wave is bigger and worse.
strategy1.tip.day.info: %s till night: build, gather, man the walls.
strategy1.tip.turn.info: %s till the next turn: taxes, food, the AI realms move.
strategy1.tip.minimap.info: Left click moves the camera (drag too), right click sends the chosen soldiers there. M: the big map.
strategy1.msg.idle_folk: %s peasants idle: every place is taken. Build more farms, woodcutters, quarries or mines and they'll go to work.
strategy1.wave.kinds: Shield-bearers hide behind a shield: break it first (ballista, catapult). Bombers run for the walls: shoot them from afar. Plague-bearers spit poison and burst into a cloud of it. Ram-bearers go for the gates. Giants break walls.
strategy1.build.outpost.info: Goes on foreign land next to yours. Put 1 soldier in it (choose a soldier, right click the outpost) and the province is yours once its garrison is beaten.
strategy1.err.build_outpost: An outpost goes wholly in a foreign province next to your land
strategy1.err.outpost_there: You have an outpost here already
strategy1.err.bridge_steep: Too steep: a bridge climbs at most a block for each block of its length
strategy1.tip.rally: right click the ground: gathering point
strategy1.build.gate.info: Rises before your soldiers, folk and allies; drops when an enemy is near
strategy1.rts.gate_make_tip: Move the mouse along the wall to choose where the gate goes, click to put it (Shift: more), right click: cancel
strategy1.rts.gate_hold_tip: Open even with an enemy near. Again: by itself once more, open for your own, shut before the enemy
strategy1.err.gate_here: A gate goes in a wall of 5 blocks or more, not at its very end
strategy1.err.gate_there: There is a gate here already
strategy1.rts.unload_tip: The ship goes to the nearest shore and puts her soldiers on it. Or choose the soldiers aboard and right click the shore
strategy1.unit.healer.info: Doesn't fight. Heals his own and allies round him: half a heart at a time.
